verses.1: And the whole land became one language and one speech.
verses.2: And they traveled early in the morning. They found a valley in the land of Shinar, and they settled there.
verses.3: And they said to each other, “Let’s make clay from the dust, and burn it to create fire. Then, that clay will become sand, and the straw will become charcoal.”
verses.4: And they said, “Let us build a city and a tower, so that its top may reach the heavens. Then we will have a name, and it will not be forgotten by all the nations.”
verses.5: And Jehovah came down to see the city and the tower that the people of God had built.
verses.6: And the LORD said, “Let them be one people, with one language. This is what will happen in their dreams. Now, nothing that they plan to do will be prevented from happening.”
verses.7: They were destroyed and killed there. Their words would not be heard by anyone else.
verses.8: And Jehovah scattered them from there, across all the land. They then stopped building the city.
verses.9: Therefore, her name was called Babylon. For there, Jehovah poured out the words of judgment upon all the earth. And from there, Jehovah spread those words throughout the entire world.
verses.10: These are the names of those who were born in that year. They gave birth to Arpachshad, two years after the flood.
verses.11: And he lived after his father had died. He ruled over Arpachshad for five hundred years. He had sons and daughters.
verses.12: And Arpachshad lived for fifty years and thirty-three years. He also had a son named Shelah.
verses.13: And Arpachshad lived after his sons. He lived for three and four hundred years. He had sons and daughters.
verses.14: And he sent a spirit for thirty years, during which time he produced a son.
verses.15: And he lived for three and four hundred years after his birth. He had sons and daughters.
verses.16: And he lived for forty-three years, and then he had a son named Paleg.
verses.17: And he lived for thirty-five years and four thousand years after his birth. He had sons and daughters.
verses.18: And he lived for thirty years, and then he had a son named Reu.
verses.19: And Pelag lived after his father, who died. He lived for forty-two years and one month. He had sons and daughters.
verses.20: And Reu lived for two hundred and thirty years, during which time he had twelve sons.
verses.21: And Reu lived after his father, and he had seven years of marriage. Then he had sons and daughters.
verses.22: Sharug lived for thirty years, and he had a son named Nachor.
verses.23: And Shurg lived after his father. He had many children and grandchildren.
verses.24: Nahor lived for forty-two years, and he had a son named Terah.
verses.25: Nahor lived for forty-five years after his birth. He had sons and daughters.
verses.26: And Terah lived for seventy years. During those years, he had sons: Abram, Nachor, and Haran.
verses.27: And these are the descendants of Terah: Terah had sons named Abraham, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran had a son named Lot.
verses.28: And Haran died before Terah’s face, in the land of his birth, in Ur Kishdi.
verses.29: And Abraham took Nahor and their wives. The wife of Abraham’s father was named Sarai, and the wife of Nahor’s father was named Milka, daughter of Haran. Abi-Milka and Abi-Yisqah.
verses.30: And she became a widow, with no children.
verses.31: And Terah took his son Abraham, and Lot, who was the son of Haran, and his daughters. His wife was Abraham’s daughter. They set out from Ur-Kasdim to go to the land of Canaan. They arrived at Haran, and they settled there.
verses.32: And there were five years and two months during those days. Then, Terah died in Haran.
